mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate in equity valuation models, increasing the present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any monetary regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate a broad-based consumer demand slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production signals an imminent manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5%) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.
